Definition: myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter)
BiblicalUsage: Mor is myrrh, the bitter, fragrant resin — the chief spice of the holy anointing oil, the bundle the beloved carries between her breasts, and the perfume on the garments of the king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe myrrh is the scent of both worship and burial: it anoints the tabernacle and it will anoint the body, and love carries it close.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
